arguments.value: User wants help configuring Linux tc bandwidth sharing on a 100 Mbps server for multiple simultaneous downloads from dynamic IP clients. They need equal bandwidth sharing: one client can use up to 100 Mbps alone, 2 clients about 50 Mbps each, 3 about 33 Mbps each, etc., with up to 10 simultaneous clients and a guaranteed minimum of 10 Mbps per client. They attempted HTB tc qdisc/class settings but currently only get 10 Mbps total when two clients download.
